notes.title: [Developer's Note #28] A girl who believes in a miracle.
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ development team.

Momiji, Farfrost, Eurydia, Yuno, and Zeusix. We have introduced the main character Arche's rivals up to this point, and now it is time for the last one.

It is here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/9d1ee3064448d41c040330cf551051ac57fd7651.png[/img]

A mysterious girl with a hood and hat that are worn so deeply that one cannot hear her facial expression.
Her name is...


[h3]Bouquet FlowerlessGarden.[/h3]


Please call her Bouquet! She is a young girl with two weapons held back-to-back in her hands. She participates in a sword tournament, hoping for a miracle.


[i]She clangs her blade, believing in a miracle.[/i]


What kind of face is hidden under the hood? You'll find out in the full game.


Lastly. We would like to show you Bouquet's post-damage appearance at..., but we'll just show you her enigmatic back view and be done with it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/7d669a307ad9ea421c6dc5c14ae34a02aa8893af.png[/img]

We will continue to bring you the latest news before anywhere else, so please add on your Wishlist and stay tuned!

Don't forget to follow us!

notes.title: [Developer's Note #26] A girl pledges for pacification.
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ development team.

We have only two more Tsurugi wielders left to introduce, who will be the main character Arche's rivals.

Here are the Tsurugi wielder we will introduce this time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/ca4cabb5937885e6725888b0a055214b258801a6.png[/img]

A girl dressed like a nurse with countless medical instruments drifting behind her.
Her name is...

[h3]Zeusix XIII[/h3]


She hides her blade, pledging for pacification.


Why does she, who seems to be a person who is involved in medical care and protects lives, dare to throw herself into a battle where they hurt each other?
The details will be revealed in the main game.


If she takes damage to her body, her costume will be damaged.
Yes, like this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/1438d46119b0eb2a22345861924cbb16b15f95e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/871dded384d773d4e135df5545d12d466967e92a.png[/img]

It seems that the intensity of the battle is telling.


We will continue to cover new characters and stories in the next issue, so if you haven't already, please do not hesitate to add on your Wishlist and wait!

We will continue to bring you the latest news through the Developer's Note before anywhere else, so please don't forget to follow us so that we can keep you updated!

notes.title: [Developer's Note #24] A girl searches for the truth.
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ development team.

Momiji, Farfrost, and Eurydia. We have introduced three rivals of Arche and now it's time for the second half. This time, the "Tsurugi" wielders we will introduce is here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/98d7af1a00447875b4af5f3a3dd5ce8cfa528461.png[/img]

A girl in oversized clothes and carrying a huge hammer that does not resemble her small body.
Her name is...

[h3]Yuno.[/h3]

Yuno, who has no relatives, participates in a sword fighting tournament to find her origins, relying on the few memories she has left.


She pelts her blade, chasing the truth.


Who is she? Why is her origin unknown? What is really at the end of her battle in pursuit of the truth? The details will be revealed in the main game.


Finally.
It is no exaggeration to say that this section needs no further explanation. We will end this section by introducing Yuno's post-damage appearance!

notes.title: [Developer's Note #22] A girl wishing for the salvation of her kingdom.
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ development team.

We have been introducing one by one from Arche's rivals, and now we would like to introduce this Tsurugi wielders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/32ebe1f511bddb5556ba20d6da8b011b2b1bae84.png[/img]

She carries a chakram-like weapon in each hand and wears a black dress.
Her name is...

[h3]Eurydia Von Valhllaheart.[/h3]

Please call her Eurydia!
Eurydia represents a country in a sword fighting tournament.


She runs her blade, wishing for the salvation of her kingdom.


It is no exaggeration to say that the fate of a country rests on her twin shoulders.
Will her wish for national salvation ever come true?　
Why did she take on such a great responsibility in the first place?

notes.title: [Developer's Note #20] A girl seeking perfection.
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ development team.

First of all, we have one announcement to make.

We have opened an official account for 213℉ on the Chinese video site bilibili!
https://space.bilibili.com/3546583687760217

If you are a bilibili user, we would be happy if you could follow us.


Now, we would like to introduce another one of the rivals of the main character, Arche, aka TSURU-chan (temporary)!

The Tsurugi wielder we will introduce this time is her here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/eae1bf175d07fb325efe164336e2928772a7f460.png[/img]


A woman dressed in a military-like uniform, carrying a double=blade with a glowing blade.
Her name is...

[h3]Farfrost LunaFilleigh.[/h3]

Please call her Farfrost!


Farfrost comes from a prestigious family that has produced many Tsurugi wielders over the generations. She takes her own way for granted, and losing is a given. With her dignified appearance, she takes on the challenge of the sword fighting tournament without any such pressure. She may be the biggest obstacle to Arche's success in the competition.


She forgives her blade by seeking perfection.


What is the perfection she seeks? And what does it mean to forgive the Tsurugi? More details will follow in due course.


One last important thing. Farfrost will also gradually damage the appearance of her equipment according to the damage received.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/aacee03415aea9280d9bd5c4a70421beea0bd007.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/82e10d2daf1970f0d529b1303eeb59a28a1765a8.png[/img]

We hope you will look forward to seeing her continue to fight with all her might, even though she has been injured!


We will continue to introduce new characters and stories in the next issue, so please add to your Wishlist and stay tuned! And we will continue to bring you the latest information before anywhere else, so please don't forget to follow us!

notes.title: [Developer's Note #18] A loyal girl.
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ Development Team.

In the previous issue #17, we introduced the synopsis of the game. The main character, Arche, a.k.a. TSURU-chan(temporary), will be battling against six rivals who are "Tsurugi wielders" just like her. We will now introduce Arche's rivals one by one!

In this first installment, we will introduce her!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/79257d69defa9751c429b47dcff5b194a271f070.png[/img]

A girl dressed in Japanese elements: a long sword, armor, umbrella, and rope.
Her name is...

[h3]Momiji Mizumura Gentosai[/h3]

You can call her Momiji!

Momiji is like a family member who studied swordsmanship at the same dojo as Arche, lived with Arche's family, and is like Arche's one and only best friend.

Arche and Momiji eventually crossed blades through a sword fighting tournament.


[i]She thrusts her blade for loyalty.
[/i]

What will Momiji think and aim for as she enters the tournament? We will introduce her details at some point in the future.


Like Arche, Momiji and her rival "Tsurugi wielders" will also gradually damage the appearance of their equipment as the player inflicts damage.

notes.title: [Developer's Note #17] TSURU-chan(temporary)'s real name is...
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ Development Team.


Have you seen our latest video released on Saturday, Dec. 2?

[previewyoutube=uNBeLv56uW4;full][/previewyoutube]
We have introduced many new characters and various battle scenes. There are still a lot of mysteries and many aspects of the game that you may be wondering about, but we will be sharing more information with you little by little through this News!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/7b5cc0c9bd9770da5e72b7c86a1bffa1e7626bb1.png[/img]

So today, let's talk about the main character. We have been calling her by the temporary name of TSURU-chan (temporary) for about a year now, and finally, here we would like to reveal her name to the public!
Her name is...

[h3]Arche A. Pleides[/h3]

From now on, please call her Arche, instead of TSURU-chan (temporary)!



Who is she such a person?
We hope you will enjoy imagining her through the synopsis of this work, which will also be published here for the [b]first time[/b]!


---

[b]<Synopsis>[/b]

Arche runs her own dojo following the footsteps of her late mother, who was known for her majestic sword skills.

She lived quietly with her younger sister as she barely got through the day teaching the neighborhood kids.

One day, an invitation finds its way to Arche. It was an invitation to a sword fighting tournament where the winner prevails a fortune and the honor of being the greatest swordsman.

Arche decides to enter the competition to protect what her mother left behind.

But what awaited her were 6 "Tsurugi" wielders.

The "Tsurugi" blade,

it possesses phenomenal powers that even slash fate.

This story depicts the 100 days of  two sisters who were guided,  bamboozled, afflicted, and saved by the blade.


---


That's all!


We will continue to introduce new characters and stories, so please add to your Wishlist and stay tuned! And please follow us as we will continue to bring you the latest information before anywhere else!

notes.title: [Developer's Note #11] It's Blue TSURU-chan (temporary) !!
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ development team.

Our main character is a girl without a name yet, "TSURU-chan (temporary)".

As she grows up, her "sword style" develops, and she is able to control countless weapons, but she has another great talent hidden away.

It is,

[h2]"Change of Style!" [/h2]

That's right.
In combat, you can switch battle styles in real time and fight in a variety of styles!
And as you switch schools, the appearance of TSURU-chan (temporary) also changes!

Today, we would like to introduce you to one of these schools, "Blue TSURU-chan (temporary)"!
(Though this is also a temporary name.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/e96cde9d1fbeef602fa7698f303326f143c18b6b.png[/img]

The first illustration of Blue TSURU-chan (temporary), designed by KUROBOSHI KOUHAKU, is now available!

There are various differences in weapons, hair style, clothes, and even in the details with the ...... original TSURU-chan (temporary), so please compare the illustrations and look for the differences!
Blue TSURU-chan (temporary) also gradually loses its clothing when it is damaged in battle.
Please try to play well so as not to damage the clothing as much as possible. Absolutely!


This time, we introduced Blue TSURU-chan (temporary)!
Of course, changing "schools" does not mean that they just look different, does it?
We will continue to introduce the charms of Blue TSURU-chan (temporary) in the next issue.
Please follow us and wait!

Thank you very much for your time!


Finally.
Your addition to the Wishlist is an encouragement to our entire development team.

It's true.
Game development is a long, long, lonely road.
It is really encouraging to know that someone is waiting for us!

Please add us to your Wishlist!

notes.title: [Developer's Note #10] TSURU-chan (temporary) can sweep away!
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ development team.

What we would like to introduce to you this time is a very powerful attack by the main character, Tsuru-chan (temporary), who manipulates a large number of weapons.

That's right, It's a
[h2]Special attack!![/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/356754f9ae55339266203b7f99e6216c891c3b0e.gif[/img]
This can be used as a finishing blow against enemies with low HP!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/9db91d5f0e4360b1380616d2803db5db6da3c301.gif[/img]
In the air, the special attack is different from the one on the ground!

These actions can be performed with a simple one-button operation, but there are many ways to make use of them in combat.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/142e15e6c31f5b3b11ed3d0e244c6bf83e2a21fe.gif[/img]
Even if only one enemy is low on HP, if you can successfully engage the surrounding enemies, you can round up all the enemies at once!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/010dc1b025eff0c3d4b696152ca23471a3b279c0.gif[/img]
Special attacks can be freely interspersed with other attacks and actions, so you can deliver the finishing blow from your own combination!

Of course, the performance of the special attacks also changes with the growth and customization of TSURU-chan's (temporary) sword style, so it is up to the player to decide whether to emphasize the special moves or the other actions!



Well, this time we have reached a milestone in this news, the "[b][u]10th[/u][/b]" issue!

We are always encouraged by the reactions we receive from everyone who reads, likes, comments, and add to Wishlist!

Thank you so much for your continued support.

The game release is still a long way off, but we will continue to update this page so that you can enjoy the behind-the-scenes development and progress of the game as much as possible in the meantime!


Thank you again for reading to the end of this issue.

Finally. As a recurring request, please add to your Wishlist!

notes.title: [Developer's Note #4] Chibi TSURU-chan (temporary)!!
notes.content:
Hi, this is the development team of 213°F.

In the last issue of "Development Note #3", we introduced the process of completing the design of the main character TSURU-chan (temporary),This time, we would like to introduce the process up to the point where TSURU-chan (temporary) starts to move in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/0c7e20af9abc705347a8723a9745e633e6d95065.gif[/img]

Once again, here is TSURU-chan (temporary) on the game screen. Her head height and other features are different from her original design! 

This version of TSURU-chan (temporary) was also created by drawing a new design. Of course, it was created by the character designer, KUROBOSHI KOUHAKU!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/15952fd09c730aae29c7d30444896f46f8b9f72f.png[/img]

It all started with a single rough illustration like this one. The rough illustration was first applied to a tentative game screen image.

Here it is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/748750ea8549e73fd8777fcf0c6abc817465e921.png[/img]

From the initial design stage like this,  the size and height of the head are adjusted with an eye to how TSURU-chan (temporary) will look on the actual game screen.

Based on the adjusted screen image, we finally proceed with the design toward completion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/855609f6e90e871454fb81093d57a6bec5dd2571.png[/img]

First, TSURU-chan (temporary) is drawn with only lines and then ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/93643c445e48ec5a60475a6a60022a443f8bd9b7.png[/img]

There it is colored and done!

How do you like it?

In order to ensure that the characters' features and charms are not lost even if their heads are changed from the original design, character designer KUROBOSHI KOUHAKU himself designed Chibi versions of each character in the game.

We can't wait to introduce the other characters to you at ..., but that will have to wait for another time!

Once the design for the Chibi version is completed like this, the next thing to do seems to be ...!
[h3]3D TSURU-chan (temporary)![/h3]
We will create her 3D model from the design.

We hope to introduce such a story in the next issue, so please follow us and wait for the next issue!

Thank you very much for reading to the end! Please don't forget to add to your Wishlist, as it will encourage our entire development team!
